analyst.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is out with a back injury, and OKC played Sunday in Miami with only nine available players, three of them on two-way deals. Indiana have lost four straight, are 3-10 without Tyrese Haliburton, and Yahoo reports a souring mood and trade chatter. Both sides are on a back-to-back, but OKC's depleted rotation makes this the softest spot they have had; the angle leans Indiana.
